title: AWS SAA vs AZ-104 vs GCP ACE: Which to Choose?
subtitle: Which one to pick in 2026, based on your profile

pros: The largest cloud job market in France and across Europe.
Senior median salary of €65k in France (Hays/APEC 2026).
A huge ecosystem of courses, community and books.
Recognized by virtually every cloud recruiter.
cons: A technical exam — not for a complete beginner.
$150 for the exam, ~120 hours of study.
Some questions take 2-3 years of experience to grasp the nuance.
certs.bestFor: You want the safest bet on the job market. If you're undecided, this is it.

pros: Best ROI if your company already runs on Microsoft (Office 365, Intune, AD).
More admin/ops-oriented than architecture-oriented — familiar ground for a sysadmin.
Strong demand in the public sector, banking and large enterprises.
cons: A smaller market than AWS outside banking and the public sector.
Salaries typically 5-10% below AWS SAA for an equivalent role.
A sprawling exam — it covers 6 very broad domains.
certs.bestFor: You come from a Windows/.NET environment, or you're targeting banking, consulting or the public sector.

pros: The most approachable exam of the three — more direct questions.
GCP is concentrated in tech companies, startups and data/ML.
A salary premium for data/ML profiles.
cons: A smaller GCP job market (strong in major tech hubs, limited elsewhere).
Fewer open roles — a longer job search.
Less recognition outside the tech/startup ecosystem.
certs.bestFor: You're targeting startups, data or ML AND you live in a major tech hub.

verdicts.profile: You're starting from zero with no attachment to a particular cloud.
verdicts.why: The AWS job market is 2-3x larger than GCP's. More openings = more chances to get paid while you learn.

verdicts.profile: You already work in a Microsoft shop (.NET, AD, Office 365).
verdicts.why: You already know half the vocabulary. The time-to-effort ROI is the best of the three.

verdicts.profile: You're targeting data, ML, or a startup in a big tech hub.
verdicts.why: GCP leads on BigQuery + Vertex AI. Data startups default to GCP.

verdicts.profile: You live outside a major tech hub and can't easily relocate.
verdicts.why: AWS is the only market with critical mass in smaller cities.

verdicts.profile: You want the cert that pays for itself fastest.
verdicts.why: The shortest payback period (~5-6 months in France, per Hays 2026).

tldr: If you're undecided, take the AWS SAA. If you already work in a Microsoft shop, take the AZ-104. The GCP ACE only makes sense if you're explicitly targeting data/ML/startups.
